title: Book X
coreMove: Hold the few names of character so conditions cannot rename you.
sourcePressure: The soul is tested for simplicity, contentment, correct names, condition-independent goodness, and clear judgment of praise, bodies, courts, and changing substance.

sourceAnchors.name: Zeno
sourceAnchors.detail: Book X has an editorial note identifying God as defined by Zeno in relation to the perfect living being.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Zeno's definition keeps the scale larger than personal comfort.

sourceAnchors.name: Plato
sourceAnchors.detail: Book X invokes Plato on dwelling within city walls while the mind ranges over human things.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Plato enters as a reminder that a narrow place does not require a narrow soul.

sourceAnchors.name: Bestiarii
sourceAnchors.detail: Book X compares clinging to a defiled life to half-devoured fighters with wild beasts begging to be kept for the next day.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The wounded arena fighter is the image of a life that keeps choosing the same claws.

counterintuition: what looks like control is actually surrender
the real problem is not outside you
tryThisNow: write down what you can control
examples: generic office meeting with laptop and coffee
parent-child bedtime conflict repeated across chapters

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective recognition, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: Simon wanting a better posting before he acts well
exampleSpecs.stakes: location becomes his excuse for thin care
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Simon writes "careful" on the top of the patient board and handles the next chart as if the posting were permanent.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Snow presses against the clinic windows before the first chart opens.

exampleSpecs.stakes: style pressure could rename dishonesty as speed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Julia rejects the sample under her own quality name before anyone else sees the defect.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Loose black thread curls from the jacket cuff.

exampleSpecs.audience: Patrick deciding whether to bury a correction
exampleSpecs.stakes: public embarrassment tests the name true
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "Put the correction above the fold online," Patrick says, before checking social reaction.

exampleSpecs.stakes: flattery could pull her from modest and rational into approval-seeking
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You watch Nora compare the plan to the flood map, not to the compliment she just received.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You see the flood map cover the glossy rendering.

exampleSpecs.audience: Matthew tempted to reward confidence over truth
exampleSpecs.stakes: the room's applause pressures the score sheet
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Which name survives the applause: fair, or impressed?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Matthew lowers the speaker score after checking unsupported claims against his notes.

exampleSpecs.audience: Anke finding a small crack before client pickup
exampleSpecs.stakes: pride wants the sale, character wants the repair
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Anke one thumbnail across the crack to know the table was not ready to carry her name.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Anke one thumbnail to hear the crack catch.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: maintain character names without needing applause
judge comfort, fame, and body by their real substance
act well in the condition already given

tryThisNowSpec: Choose one name of character you claim, then identify the condition that most often makes you drop it.
